digest.component_or_area: Jira family adapters: rich-text reconciliation (Cloud ADF + DC wiki)
propositions: Cloud Markdown descriptions and comments must encode as structured ADF (not plain-text paragraphs) through the production codec path, achieving 99.75% idempotent Markdown↔ADF round-trip over the corpus.

Data Center safe Markdown descriptions and comments must render as native Jira wiki markup (not literal source) through production codec paths, with zero monotonic length decay over repeated passes and fallback without data loss on pandoc absence or timeout.

Bidirectional echo-safety must suppress unchanged second-pass commits via ADR-0026 per-binding baselines, change-gated rich_sha hashing, and three-way LWW conflict detection while preserving Jira-native constructs (panels, mentions, dates) via origin gating.

Comments must sync append-only through the same rich-text codec as descriptions using persistent local-comment-key→Jira-comment-ID mappings, with comment creation routed through codec-aware send paths for both Cloud and DC.

All six epic child stories (wiki renderer, ADF codec, DC robustness, cutover+echo-safety, comment sync, live harness) must land to origin/main at LLM-Review +1 / Verified +1 before the epic can close.
Live Jira DC acceptance via operator-dispatched external integration workflow must confirm rendered HTML (expand=renderedFields), conflict safety, and zero-update convergence for the cutover.
